description: Find BotSpot-provided public research datasets the agent can query. Pass datasetId alone to inspect a selected dataset contract, schemas, units, coverage and historical guarantees. Catalog metadata is not observations or a permission grant. Use this for versioned symbol-membership universes, public news discovery, or when unsure whether SEC, Treasury, BLS, BEA, OFR, or CFTC is the right source. Universes contain membership only. This tool does not provide real-time prices, broker data, or premium news.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from the same owner and catalog search. Restart discovery if expired.

datasetId.description: Describe this registered dataset instead of listing matches. Use datasetId alone to retrieve query/result schemas, units, operations, coverage and historical guarantees.

query.description: Natural-language search text, such as SEC filings, GDP, CPI, Treasury debt, repo, or COT.

name: search_data_catalog
title: Discover or describe market research data
